root_selection: timing-only pilot selects 1 or 2 time-spaced scheduled student decisions per seed; target 0/10000 if two, nearest5000 if one; all-candidate labels never used for root selection
scope_resolution: retain six non-L45 marked points with original teacher prefixes; >10000 ticks are explicit named-point exceptions; two L45 points deferred under explicit final sentence of appendix B
candidates: all engine legal planting AND shovels plus canonical wait:60/timeout; root shovel outcomes remain separate from production representable candidates
terminal_policy: immediately after candidate, same frozen search teacher all the way to terminal; world and search noise common across root candidates
pilot: first seed per ordinary level, initial/nearest5000 roots plus marked points; one future, representative first/middle/last cells per plant packet + one shovel + wait; only CPU timing used
sampling_budget_gate: freeze root density and sample count after pilot CPU projections, preserving all legal candidates and >=2 seeds per level; reserve >=1200 CPU seconds for audits/repro/report
uncertainty: small common-future cohort; strict/tie/thresholded rankings and reset-seed clusters; observed improvements do not imply independent significance
